name: Daniel Adamov
intro: I'm a 20-year-old Game Development student at Howest DAE in Kortrijk, Belgium, with a background in high-level mathematics and a tendency to gravitate toward hard problems - particularly on the systems behind games, engine and graphics side. My goal is to build an ambitious game with a promising team, contributing from the fundamentals up. My other obsession is astrophysics, which keeps finding its way into my projects. I'm currently looking for a programming internship from February to at least June 2027.
